package postgres_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	plannerpostgres "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/courseplan"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/pedagogy"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// This bounded persistence proof runs only against the explicitly named NEW T19
// database. It never reaches owner services, applies the regular migration task,
// resets existing state, or claims live end-to-end coverage.
func TestT19PlanningCheckpointPostgresLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	dsn := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("PLANNER_T19_DATABASE_URL"))
	if dsn == "" {
		t.Skip("PLANNER_T19_DATABASE_URL not configured")
	}
	cfg, e := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dsn)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "remediation_t19_planner_test" || cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "127.0.0.1" || cfg.ConnConfig.Port != 58998 {
		t.Fatal("T19 requires the exact new isolated database at127.0.0.1:58998")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 45*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	pool, e := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	if e = pool.Ping(ctx); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	var foreign int
	if e = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='project_authoring_flow' AND column_name='staging_receipt_json'`).Scan(&foreign); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if foreign != 0 {
		t.Fatal("T19 database includes foreign018")
	}
	store := plannerpostgres.Store{Pool: pool}
	// This exact marker/hash is minted only by t19NewCheckpointJob in this named
	// isolated database. Retain and terminalize earlier header-guard fixtures;
	// composer jobs have their own distinct request identity and intent.
	cleaned, e := pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE course_plan_request SET status='FAILED',failure_code='T19_TEST_FIXTURE_TERMINAL',claim_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,completed_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE status='PLANNING' AND goal_code='go.backend' AND request_hash=repeat('a',64) AND intent_json->>'desired_outcome'='Learn Go'`)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	t.Logf("terminalized retained owned header fixtures: %d", cleaned.RowsAffected())

	t.Run("empty_down_up_down_up_atomic", func(t *testing.T) {
		var n int
		if e = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM course_planning_input_checkpoint`).Scan(&n); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		if n != 0 {
			t.Skip("retained pins already exist; destructive empty-schema lifecycle not repeated")
		}
		tx, e := pool.Begin(ctx)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		defer tx.Rollback(ctx)
		for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
			for _, direction := range []string{"down", "up"} {
				body := t19MigrationBody(t, direction)
				if _, e = tx.Exec(ctx, body); e != nil {
					t.Fatalf("cycle%d %s: %v", i, direction, e)
				}
			}
		}
		// Roll back the isolated lifecycle proof; the root-prepared schema survives.
		if e = tx.Rollback(ctx); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
	})
	r, input := t19NewCheckpointJob(t, ctx, store)
	defer t19TerminalFixture(t, pool, r.ID, r.StudentID)
	if e = store.CheckpointPlanningInput(ctx, r, input, time.Now().UTC()); e != nil {
		t.Fatalf("pin input: %v", e)
	}
	if e = store.CheckpointPlanningInput(ctx, r, input, time.Now().UTC()); e != nil {
		t.Fatalf("identical replay: %v", e)
	}
	reloaded, e := store.GetPlanningInput(ctx, r)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(reloaded.NormalizedContext, input.NormalizedContext) || reloaded.InputHash != input.InputHash {
		t.Fatal("BYTEA changed exact context/hash")
	}
	changed := input
	changed.Profile.WeeklyMinutes++
	if e = store.CheckpointPlanningInput(ctx, r, changed, time.Now().UTC()); !errors.Is(e, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("tampered self hash: %v", e)
	}
	changed, e = domain.NewPlanningInputCheckpoint(changed)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = store.CheckpointPlanningInput(ctx, r, changed, time.Now().UTC()); !errors.Is(e, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("different immutable replay: %v", e)
	}
	generated, e := domain.NewGeneratedCourseCheckpoint(input, input.Draft)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	t.Run("stale_claim_waiter", func(t *testing.T) {
		tx, e := pool.Begin(ctx)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		defer tx.Rollback(ctx)
		if _, e = tx.Exec(ctx, `SELECT id FROM course_plan_request WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE`, r.ID); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		done := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() { done <- store.CheckpointGeneratedCourse(ctx, r, generated, time.Now().UTC()) }()
		deadline := time.Now().Add(3 * time.Second)
		var waiting bool
		for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
			if e = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND wait_event_type='Lock' AND query LIKE '%course_plan_request%FOR UPDATE%')`).Scan(&waiting); e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			if waiting {
				break
			}
			time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
		}
		if !waiting {
			t.Fatal("stale writer did not reach row lock")
		}
		token := uuid.NewString()
		if _, e = tx.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE course_plan_request SET claim_token=$2 WHERE id=$1`, r.ID, token); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		if e = tx.Commit(ctx); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		if e = <-done; !errors.Is(e, domain.ErrConflict) {
			t.Fatalf("stale waiting writer: %v", e)
		}
		r.ClaimToken = token
	})
	if e = store.CheckpointGeneratedCourse(ctx, r, generated, time.Now().UTC()); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	actual, e := store.GetGeneratedCourse(ctx, r)
	if e != nil || actual.ArtifactHash != generated.ArtifactHash {
		t.Fatalf("reconstruct artifact: %v", e)
	}
	lessons := []domain.CourseLessonBinding{}
	for _, m := range generated.Course.Modules {
		for _, s := range m.Sections {
			for _, l := range s.Lessons {
				lessons = append(lessons, domain.CourseLessonBinding{LessonID: uuid.NewString(), LessonRevisionID: uuid.NewString(), Order: len(lessons), Targets: l.Targets})
			}
		}
	}
	receipt, e := domain.NewCourseEnsureCheckpoint(input, generated, domain.EnsureCourseResult{CourseID: uuid.NewString(), Reused: true, Lessons: lessons})
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = store.CheckpointCourseEnsure(ctx, r, receipt, time.Now().UTC()); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	receiptRead, e := store.GetCourseEnsure(ctx, r)
	if e != nil || receiptRead.ReceiptHash != receipt.ReceiptHash {
		t.Fatalf("reconstruct receipt: %v", e)
	}
	t.Run("request_binding_and_internal_resolution", func(t *testing.T) {
		wrong := r
		wrong.RequestHash = strings.Repeat("b", 64)
		if _, e = store.GetPlanningInput(ctx, wrong); !errors.Is(e, domain.ErrValidation) {
			t.Fatalf("wrong supplied binding: %v", e)
		}
		if _, e = pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE course_plan_request SET request_hash=$2 WHERE id=$1`, r.ID, strings.Repeat("c", 64)); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		if _, e = store.GetPlanningInput(ctx, r); !errors.Is(e, domain.ErrValidation) {
			t.Fatalf("mutated stored binding accepted: %v", e)
		}
		if _, e = pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE course_plan_request SET request_hash=$2 WHERE id=$1`, r.ID, r.RequestHash); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		r.LearningPathID = uuid.NewString()
		if e = store.ResolveLearningPath(ctx, r.ID, r.ClaimToken, r.LearningPathID, time.Now().UTC()); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		if c, e := store.GetPlanningInput(ctx, r); e != nil || c.OriginalPath != nil || c.OriginalLearningPathID != "" {
			t.Fatalf("INITIAL path resolution reinterpreted pin: %v", e)
		}
	})
	t.Run("immutable_rows_and_retained_down_refusal", func(t *testing.T) {
		for _, table := range []string{"course_planning_input_checkpoint", "course_planning_generated_checkpoint", "course_planning_ensure_checkpoint"} {
			for _, sql := range []string{"UPDATE " + table + " SET checkpointed_at=checkpointed_at WHERE request_id=$1", "DELETE FROM " + table + " WHERE request_id=$1"} {
				if _, e = pool.Exec(ctx, sql, r.ID); e == nil {
					t.Fatalf("accepted mutation%s", sql)
				}
			}
			if _, e = pool.Exec(ctx, "TRUNCATE "+table+" CASCADE"); e == nil {
				t.Fatalf("accepted truncate%s", table)
			}
		}
		tx, e := pool.Begin(ctx)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		defer tx.Rollback(ctx)
		if _, e = tx.Exec(ctx, t19MigrationBody(t, "down")); e == nil || !strings.Contains(e.Error(), "cannot discard retained planning checkpoints") {
			t.Fatalf("DOWN did not refuse retained pins: %v", e)
		}
		_ = tx.Rollback(ctx)
		if _, e = store.GetCourseEnsure(ctx, r); e != nil {
			t.Fatalf("DOWN destroyed pins: %v", e)
		}
	})
	t.Run("privileged_tamper_detected_and_restored", func(t *testing.T) {
		var raw []byte
		if e = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT payload_bytes FROM course_planning_input_checkpoint WHERE request_id=$1`, r.ID).Scan(&raw); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		altered := input
		altered.Profile.WeeklyMinutes++
		tampered, e := json.Marshal(altered)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		t19ReplaceTestPayload(t, ctx, pool, r.ID, tampered)
		if _, e = store.GetPlanningInput(ctx, r); !errors.Is(e, domain.ErrValidation) {
			t.Fatalf("read accepted valid byte SHA but invalid semantic hash: %v", e)
		}
		t19ReplaceTestPayload(t, ctx, pool, r.ID, raw)
		if _, e = store.GetPlanningInput(ctx, r); e != nil {
			t.Fatalf("restored pin: %v", e)
		}
	})
	t.Run("expired_claim_and_terminal_retention", func(t *testing.T) {
		if _, e = pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE course_plan_request SET lease_until=clock_timestamp()-interval '1 second' WHERE id=$1`, r.ID); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		if e = store.CheckpointCourseEnsure(ctx, r, receipt, time.Now().UTC()); !errors.Is(e, domain.ErrConflict) {
			t.Fatalf("expired claim accepted: %v", e)
		}
		if _, e = pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE course_plan_request SET status='FAILED',claim_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE id=$1`, r.ID); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		if _, e = store.GetCourseEnsure(ctx, r); e != nil {
			t.Fatalf("terminal did not retain receipt: %v", e)
		}
	})
	t.Run("header_sha_checks_and_read_errors", func(t *testing.T) {
		other, otherInput := t19NewCheckpointJob(t, ctx, store)
		defer t19TerminalFixture(t, pool, other.ID, other.StudentID)
		raw, _ := json.Marshal(otherInput)
		sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
		_, e = pool.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO course_planning_input_checkpoint(request_id,student_id,request_hash,goal_code,checkpoint_hash,payload_bytes,payload_sha256,write_claim,checkpointed_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,clock_timestamp())`, other.ID, other.StudentID, other.RequestHash, other.GoalCode, otherInput.InputHash, raw, strings.Repeat("0", 64), other.ClaimToken)
		if e == nil {
			t.Fatal("DB accepted wrong byte SHA")
		}
		_, e = pool.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO course_planning_input_checkpoint(request_id,student_id,request_hash,goal_code,checkpoint_hash,payload_bytes,payload_sha256,write_claim,checkpointed_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,clock_timestamp())`, other.ID, uuid.NewString(), other.RequestHash, other.GoalCode, otherInput.InputHash, raw, hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), other.ClaimToken)
		if e == nil {
			t.Fatal("DB accepted mismatched Student header")
		}
		canceled, stop := context.WithCancel(ctx)
		stop()
		if _, e = store.GetPlanningInput(canceled, r); e == nil || errors.Is(e, domain.ErrValidation) || errors.Is(e, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			t.Fatalf("read error was translated to validation/notfound: %v", e)
		}
	})
}
func t19MigrationBody(t *testing.T, direction string) string {
	t.Helper()
	b, e := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/019_course_planning_input_checkpoint." + direction + ".sql")
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	s := strings.TrimSpace(string(b))
	s = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(s, "BEGIN;"))
	s = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimSuffix(s, "COMMIT;"))
	return s
}
func t19NewCheckpointJob(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, store plannerpostgres.Store) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, domain.PlanningInputCheckpoint) {
	t.Helper()
	now := time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)
	r := domain.CoursePlanRequest{ID: uuid.NewString(), StudentID: uuid.NewString(), IdempotencyKey: uuid.NewString(), RequestHash: strings.Repeat("a", 64), GoalCode: "go.backend", Intent: domain.PlanningIntent{Source: domain.PlanningSourceStudent, Reason: domain.PlanningReasonInitial, DesiredOutcome: "Learn Go"}, Status: domain.CoursePlanPlanning, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now, NextAttemptAt: now}
	var e error
	r.Intent, e = domain.NormalizePlanningIntent(r.Intent)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if r, _, e = store.CreateOrGet(ctx, r); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	r.ClaimToken = uuid.NewString()
	lease := now.Add(15 * time.Minute)
	r.LeaseUntil = &lease
	if _, e = store.Pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE course_plan_request SET claim_token=$2,lease_until=$3 WHERE id=$1`, r.ID, r.ClaimToken, lease); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	graph, e := store.GetPublishedGoalGraph(ctx, r.GoalCode)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	policy, e := store.GetActivePolicyBundle(ctx)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	profile := domain.StudentPlanningProfile{DirectionCode: "backend", SelfAssessedExperience: "beginner", DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}, GoalCode: r.GoalCode, PreferredLanguage: "en", WeeklyMinutes: 60, PreferredPace: "standard", ProfileVersion: domain.StudentPlanningProfileVersion}
	mastery := []domain.TargetMastery{}
	for _, target := range graph.Targets {
		mastery = append(mastery, domain.TargetMastery{Target: target.Ref, State: domain.MasteryUnknown, PolicyVersion: domain.StudentMasteryPolicyVersion})
	}
	result, e := courseplan.BuildDeterministicCourseForIntent(graph, profile, mastery, policy, r.Intent, pedagogy.NewDefaultRegistry())
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	input, e := domain.NewPlanningInputCheckpoint(domain.PlanningInputCheckpoint{RequestID: r.ID, StudentID: r.StudentID, RequestHash: r.RequestHash, GoalCode: r.GoalCode, Intent: r.Intent, Profile: profile, Mastery: mastery, Graph: graph, Policy: policy, Draft: result.Course, Fingerprint: result.Fingerprint, NormalizedContext: result.NormalizedContext, GapTargets: result.GapTargets})
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	return r, input
}
func t19ReplaceTestPayload(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, id string, raw []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	tx, e := pool.Begin(ctx)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	defer tx.Rollback(ctx)
	if _, e = tx.Exec(ctx, `ALTER TABLE course_planning_input_checkpoint DISABLE TRIGGER USER`); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	if _, e = tx.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE course_planning_input_checkpoint SET payload_bytes=$2,payload_sha256=$3 WHERE request_id=$1`, id, raw, hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if _, e = tx.Exec(ctx, `ALTER TABLE course_planning_input_checkpoint ENABLE TRIGGER USER`); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = tx.Commit(ctx); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
}

func t19TerminalFixture(t *testing.T, pool *pgxpool.Pool, id, studentID string) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if _, e := pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE course_plan_request SET status='FAILED',failure_code='T19_TEST_FIXTURE_TERMINAL',claim_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,completed_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=$1 AND student_id=$2`, id, studentID); e != nil {
		t.Errorf("retain terminal owned fixture: %v", e)
	}
}
